title: Farewell and Promise
next_chapter_hook: "Just as Chen Ji was about to entrust everything, a voice from the slumbering consciousness transmitted a whisper that froze his entire body——"

text.content: "The first light of dawn pierced through the thin mist, falling upon the sleeping form of the Demonic Path commander. Chen Ji stood alone before that motionless body, the morning light stretching his shadow long, like his heavy heart at this moment. The Demonic Path commander's face was peaceful as if merely asleep, rather than that of a warrior who had exhausted his last strength to cover their escape. Chen Ji slowly knelt on one knee, bringing himself level with the sleeping figure."

dialogue.content: "Rest assured. The Ultimate Chess Master's game, I will shatter it with my own hands."

text.content: "Chen Ji's voice was soft, yet every word was clear, as if making an oath with someone who could hear. He extended his hand, fingertips gently touching the Demonic Path commander's icy forehead. In that instant, a faint stream of consciousness, like gossamer, flowed into his spiritual awareness——that was the final thought left behind by the Demonic Path commander, like a candle flame in the wind, yet carrying an inexplicable warmth."

"Within that stream of consciousness, Chen Ji saw a blurred vision: in endless darkness, a massive chessboard hung in the void, the Chess Player hidden behind the scenes, and every piece on the board silently spoke of fate's injustice. That was the corner of Heavenly Secrets the Demonic Path commander had captured with his last strength——the existence of the Ultimate Chess Master, far older and more terrifying than any of them had imagined."

"Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, his pupils reflecting the brightening dawn sky. His hand trembled slightly, yet he did not withdraw it; instead, he pressed more firmly against the Demonic Path commander's forehead. The Tianji Record gently turned in his Mental Sea, the characters on the fragment flowing as if recording this promise that transcended life and death."

"Ye Qing's voice came from afar. Chen Ji turned to see two figures racing through the morning mist toward him. Ye Qing, dressed in black, her eyes behind the veil filled with worry; Su Qingyao in cyan robes, her expression still cold, yet those eyes watching him intently concealed undisguised concern."

"Chen Ji rose slowly, turning to face his two arriving allies. Morning light spread out behind him, shrouding him in a faint golden glow. His expression remained calm, yet deep within his eyes burned something fierce——the weight of a promise, and the bearing of responsibility."

dialogue.content: "How long have you been standing here?"
"Not long. Just long enough to see the sunrise."

text.content: "Chen Ji's voice was light, yet it caused Su Qingyao's brow to furrow slightly. She stepped closer, her gaze sweeping over the sleeping body, then falling on Chen Ji's hand pressed against its forehead, finally landing on those seemingly calm eyes. She knew him too well——this calm was always but a facade before the storm."

choice.prompt: "Su Qingyao approached Chen Ji and asked quietly: 'What promise did you make?'"

choices.description: "Tell them the truth about the Ultimate Chess Master and his own promise"
choices.visible_cost: "Let them bear the same heavy fate"
choices.visible_reward: "Gain deeper trust from his allies and resolve to fight side by side"
choices.risk_hint: "The weight of truth might shake their faith"

text.content: "Chen Ji withdrew his hand, turning to face Su Qingyao and Ye Qing. Morning light outlined a clear silhouette behind him; his gaze slowly swept across both their faces before he spoke: 'I have seen the existence of the Ultimate Chess Master.'"

dialogue.content: "The Ultimate Chess Master? That legendary being who controls everything?"

choices.memory_label: 坦诚相告终极棋手之事

choices.description: "Only say he promised someone something, temporarily concealing the truth about the Ultimate Chess Master"
choices.visible_cost: "Might put allies in danger without their knowledge"
choices.visible_reward: "Protect them from being crushed by the weight of truth"
choices.risk_hint: "When the truth is revealed, it might damage trust"

text.content: "Chen Ji gave a faint smile, one carrying a hint of weariness: 'It's nothing serious. Just promised an old friend that I would walk the path he couldn't complete.'"

"Su Qingyao did not press further. She simply watched Chen Ji quietly, those eyes seeming to see through all pretense, reaching straight to his deepest secrets. But she ultimately did not expose him, merely nodding slightly and stepping back, leaving space for Chen Ji and the sleeping body."

"Ye Qing's voice trembled. She crouched down, gently touching the Demonic Path commander's icy hand. In the morning light, that peaceful face seemed merely to have fallen into sleep, ready to open his eyes at any moment and say with a smile, 'Don't worry.' But everyone knew those eyes would never open again."

"Chen Ji watched Ye Qing's back, his gaze flickering. He recalled the thread of consciousness the Demonic Path commander had transmitted before death——that was not merely a farewell, but a commission. The Demonic Path commander had placed something important into his hands, and he must bear this weight."

choice.prompt: "How will Chen Ji handle the Demonic Path commander's body?"

choices.description: "Give the sleeping body of the Demonic Path commander to Mo Xiansheng for safekeeping, awaiting the possibility of revival"
choices.visible_cost: "Requires consuming resources from the Tianji Record"
choices.visible_reward: "Preserve the possibility of revival, laying groundwork for the future"
choices.risk_hint: "Will Mo Xiansheng be willing to bear this responsibility?"

text.content: "Chen Ji took a deep breath, drawing a mystical trajectory in the air. The Tianji Record fragment unfurled slowly in his Mental Sea, and Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul emerged from it, a detached gaze falling upon the sleeping body."

dialogue.content: "'Interesting... to entrust such an important existence to me.'"

choices.memory_label: 将魔道主帅托付墨先生

choices.text: "Bring back to the Holy Sect for burial"
choices.description: "Respect the Demonic Path commander's affiliation, let Ye Qing take him back to the Demonic Holy Sect"
choices.visible_cost: "Might lose the chance to revive the Demonic Path commander"
choices.visible_reward: "Fulfill a warrior's wish to return home"
choices.risk_hint: "There might be other factions within the Holy Sect with designs on him"

text.content: "Chen Ji looked at Ye Qing and said softly: 'He was a man of your Demonic Path. Perhaps... he should go home.' Ye Qing's eyes instantly reddened; she said nothing, merely nodding heavily."

"Just then, the sleeping body suddenly trembled slightly. Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply——he sensed it, that wisp of consciousness about to dissipate had, at the final moment, transmitted an image: a chessboard, a blurry figure standing at its center, and in that figure's hand, a bloodstained chess piece."

"That was the clue the Demonic Path commander, with his last ounce of strength, had left for Chen Ji. A bloodstained chess piece——what did that represent? A person, or a critical moment? Chen Ji firmly engraved this image in his mind; the Tianji Record fragment turned automatically, recording it."

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji, you look terrible. What happened?"

text.content: "Chen Ji shook his head, temporarily pressing that image to the depths of his heart. He turned to face Su Qingyao and Ye Qing, morning light casting dappled shadows across his face. His expression remained calm, yet deep within his eyes burned a steadfast flame——the weight of a promise, and the resolve to break the deadlock."

dialogue.content: "Let's go. We still have much to do."

text.content: "Chen Ji cast one final glance at the sleeping body, silently vowing in his heart: Wait for me, Ultimate Chess Master. No matter how deep you hide, no matter how vast this chess game, I will drag you out. The Demonic Path commander's sacrifice will not be in vain, and the debt you owe will be repaid with interest. The morning breeze brushed past as the three walked shoulder to shoulder toward the distance, their figures gradually vanishing into the brightening horizon."
